name: Warrior
blurb: Frontline bruiser who turns pain into Rage and hits hardest at death's door.

passive.name: Berserker
passive.text: The lower your HP, the harder you hit: up to +80% damage at the brink of death. Losing HP also gives Rage.

rageOnHurt._not: Ömer 2026-10-17 (wr1 Berserker): kaybedilen can maks canın %1'i başına perHpPercent Rage, vuruş başına en fazla perHitCap. İlk değer PROVİZYON (balance-tester).
